summary: Backend-only verification of the generalized orphan cleanup (iteration 21). PRIMARY GATE PASSED: an independent Mongo scan (/app/test_reports/orphan_scan_iter21.py, written from scratch, not reusing the script's logic) reports 0 orphan docs in ALL 6 child collections (attractions 17, stops 614, hotels 150, expenses 40, exchange_rates 22, trip_members 1150 docs scanned; 0 orphans each, 0 docs missing the trip_id field). cleanup_orphan_expenses.py run twice: rc=0, 'orphans_found=0 removed=0' both times, per_coll all zeros -> idempotent. Regression: orphan_expenses_test.py 2/2 PASS, orphan_cascade_iter20_test.py 7/7 PASS (TestDbIntegrity, which failed on legacy hotels/exchange_rates in iter20, is now GREEN), sprint_ab_test.py + trip_map_test.py + trip_summary_test.py 42/42 PASS. Added /app/backend/tests/orphan_cascade_iter21_test.py (2/2 PASS) which seeds a trip with 1 stop + 1 hotel + 1 attraction + 1 expense(stop_id=null) + 1 expense(stop_id set) + 1 explicit PUT exchange-rate, asserts pre-delete count>0 in ALL 6 collections (iter20 only asserted 4), DELETEs the trip and asserts 0 rows remain everywhere plus trips=0. Stress check: ran the ENTIRE tests/ dir under pytest-xdist loadscope (the same parallel pattern that produced the original 2026-08-20 09:30 race) -> 263 passed / 22 failed, and a re-scan afterwards still reports TOTAL_ORPHANS=0 across all 6 collections, i.e. the race window did not recur. The 22 failures are unrelated to this iteration (see minor issues).

minor.issue: PRE-EXISTING / config-dependent, not a regression. /app/backend/.env has ORS_MOCK="0" (real ORS key active), but these legacy suites hard-code the mocked distance table, so they fail on real ORS values (e.g. Roma-Milano assert 572.0 == 574.0, Roma-Napoli 225.9 vs 225.0, London-Paris 462.0 vs 460.0). Either gate these suites with pytest.mark.skipif(ORS_MOCK!=1) or assert with a tolerance. No app-code defect.

FLAKY (~1 run in the full parallel suite): RemoteDisconnected('Remote end closed connection without response') when many real-ORS stop creations run concurrently under xdist. Passes 1/1 in isolation. Likely request timeout/keep-alive under load, not a logic bug.

Cascade omits db.trip_presence (which does carry trip_id and IS purged in members.py:183). Low severity because trip_presence has a 60s TTL index (db.py:67) so rows self-expire, but for symmetry delete_trip should also delete_many trip_presence, and trip_presence should ideally be added to CHILD_COLLECTIONS in the cleanup script.

action_items: Nothing blocking — the orphan cleanup goal is fully met and verified (0 orphans, idempotent, cascade proven live for all 6 collections).
Optional: add db.trip_presence.delete_many({'trip_id': trip_id}) to trips.py::delete_trip and add 'trip_presence' to CHILD_COLLECTIONS for completeness.
Optional housekeeping: legacy phase5* suites need an ORS_MOCK guard or km tolerance so the full-suite run is green with ORS_MOCK=0.
Optional: the dev Mongo now holds 789 trips / 1208 trip_members of accumulated TEST_ debris; consider a purge-by-title-prefix maintenance script.
critical_code_review_comments: cleanup_orphan_expenses.py uses coll.distinct('trip_id') which is capped by the 16MB BSON limit; with 1200+ trip_members rows it is fine today, but an aggregation pipeline ($group / $lookup on trips) would be safer at scale.

main() returns total_removed but __main__ always sys.exit(0) — intentional (keeps CI green) but means a non-zero removal is not detectable via exit code; callers must grep the 'removed=' line. Documented behaviour, matches the idempotency test.

The script's file name (cleanup_orphan_expenses.py) no longer reflects its generalized scope over all child collections; consider renaming to cleanup_orphan_children.py with a shim, since the module docstring is now the only hint.

success_rate.backend: 100% on all in-scope suites (9/9 orphan+cascade, 42/42 regression, 2/2 new iter21); 92% (263/285) on the entire tests/ dir, all 22 failures pre-existing/config-related

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the historical orphans was a legacy 2026-08-20 09:30-09:34 pytest-xdist window predating the complete cascade in trips.py::delete_trip; the live code path (lines 278-285) purges attractions/stops/hotels/expenses/exchange_rates/trip_members before deleting the trip and was already correct. The generalized cleanup script removed the 11 remaining legacy docs (10 hotels + 1 exchange_rates) in the prior run; this iteration independently confirms 0 orphans remain, that a re-run removes nothing (idempotent), and that a live create-then-delete leaves zero rows in every child collection.
